messages.en: Where did you disappear to? I'm already at the café.
I just went to get a drink. I'll be there in a bit.
I've decided to turn down that offer.
I still respect your decision. I just want to understand why, if you're comfortable sharing.
I've tried calling Mr Rahman, but he didn't pick up. Want me to try again?
Just send him a WhatsApp message for now. He might be in a meeting.

messages.en: I'm going to the market with Dad for a bit. Want to come along?
Yeah! I'll wait outside your place, then.
